prOriginalConhecido.nota: Upstream calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy. Found by head branch fix-collective-events-have-only-one-team-attendee-on-the-google-event-7754-cal-1267; benchmark head de62829 is the PR's last commit and squash c4e5d168 has the same 22-file diff (only unrelated main-merge drift in imports). Files later moved: EventManager -> packages/features/bookings/lib, CalendarManager -> packages/features/calendars/lib, handleNewBooking -> service/RegularBookingService + handleNewBooking/loadUsers.

tps.bug: In Google createEvent, when no destination calendar matches the credentialId, the hangout-link events.patch is called with an undefined calendarId and fails, so the Meet link is not added to the event description.
tps.evidenciaOpus: selectedCalendar is now `destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` (CalendarService.ts:147-149), which can be undefined; the insert falls back to "primary" (:154) but the follow-up events.patch passes `calendarId: selectedCalendar` (:168) raw. Before the PR selectedCalendar already defaulted to "primary", so the PR introduces the undefined calendarId.
tps.evidenciaAstra: CalendarService.ts:147-154 now allows selectedCalendar to be undefined and applies the "primary" fallback only to insertion; the subsequent Meet-description patch still passes selectedCalendar directly at lines 165-175. This case is reachable for destinations without credentialId (packages/core/EventManager.ts:375-380), causing the patch to fail and omit the Meet link from the description; previously selectedCalendar itself included the fallback.
